column1: Notes and Footnotes (Simpson Strong-Tie Hurricane Ties, Lateral Plates & Framing Angles - C-C-2026 & strongtie.com):
1. Allowable loads have been increased by C_D = 1.60 for wind or earthquake loading; no further increase is allowed. Reduce where other load durations govern.

2. Simultaneous Multi-Axis Loading Check (Unity Equation vs. 75% Rule): When a hurricane tie is subjected to simultaneous Uplift (U) and Lateral forces (F1, F2), check BOTH: (a) Unity Equation: (U / U_allow) + (F1 / F1_allow) + (F2 / F2_allow) <= 1.0, OR (b) Simpson 75% Rule (where permitted by specific series footnotes): design load in each orthogonal direction shall not exceed 0.75 x Allowable Load in that direction, and total simultaneous load checks must satisfy catalog footnote limits.

3. When single-sided ties (such as H2.5A, H3, H8) are installed on one side of a rafter/truss, lateral load F1 must act toward the connector flange unless installed in symmetric pairs on opposite sides of the rafter.

4. For LTP4 installed over wood structural panel (WSP) sheathing using 1-1/2 in. fasteners: multiply allowable load by 0.72 over 3/8 in. sheathing or 0.64 over 1/2 in. sheathing. Using 2-1/2 in. nails (0.148"x2.5") or #9x2.5" Strong-Drive SD9212 screws over <= 1/2 in. WSP achieves 100% (1.00x) of tabulated load.
